name: ProsperoBrowser
description: A WebKit web browser for the PS5, driven by the controller, with tabs, bookmarks and video playback.
longDescription: ProsperoBrowser is a free, open-source web browser for jailbroken PS5 consoles, built on a port of WebKit. It is made for the TV and the controller: a pointer moved with the stick, the console keyboard with a built-in fallback, tabs, bookmarks, history and session restore, element fullscreen, and HTML5 video and audio (MP4, WebM and HLS) through an ffmpeg engine. The interface is in English and Russian. It is a homebrew project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment.
author: kvaps
